notes: Assumptions that change the number: pumpkin taken, not butternut (butternut would add ~140 kcal to the batch, ~25 a serving); of the 4 tbsp frying oil ~75 % (40 g) is soaked up by the fritters; the caramel sauce (60 g butter, 150 g brown sugar, 125 ml cream) is all eaten, and it is ~60 % of the energy. Sanity check by batch total: Simply Delicious's gran's pumpkin fritters with a cream caramel are 148 kcal × 20 = ~2960 kcal; ours is 2648. The Cinnamon Jar's is 304 × 12 = ~3650. Spinneys lists 181 kcal a serving for 4–6, but without the full caramel sauce.
